negative_reviews.author: Tanjila Akthar
negative_reviews.text: Ok food. Waiting time really long. But amazing service by Charlotte W

negative_reviews.author: Jasmine Patel
negative_reviews.text: My partner and I were really excited to try this new ramen spot out, however we were disappointed with our experience. When ordering drinks, we were told they hadn't got any coke in stock and it just got worse from there really.. the ramen lacked flavour, the broth tasted powdery, the boiled egg was stone cold and the noodles were stiff. The whole dish tasted cheap - nothing authentic about it and nothing compared to the real thing in Japan. Sorry, I would not recommend this place!

issues: A kitchen allergy incident involving vegetable broth and a chicken ramen was raised, and allergen awareness training for the kitchen team is now a priority.
A video showing a mouse circulated publicly; the meeting concluded the impact had been minimal, but it sits alongside the site's other standards issues.
Covers fell on the week while spend per head rose, and sales came in ahead of target.

Deliveroo delivery management is a problem: an incorrect bag was handed out in a mix up and there is a run of missing item claims, so new protocols are being introduced to write the item count on the bag and photograph the packed food as evidence.
The site rating has slipped and management have set a daily Google review target to recover it; a realistic daily target was agreed in place of the much higher one that had been proposed.
Negative reviews concern staff, long waits, speed of service and loud music, so music will now be quieter and more relaxed through the day and upbeat at night.
Labour is high because of training hours for new starters and kitchen adjustments, and the rota will be trimmed with the area manager.
Staff turnover has come from letting people go and from delays in replacing them, compounded by absence and morale problems.
There is recurring lateness in the team that needs addressing directly.
Food and drink variance problems include a matcha classification error and wastage that is not being tracked often enough.
The site has run out of stock on recent Sundays.
General manager and head chef meetings surfaced past communication problems where several staff were distracting the kitchen at the same time.
Region-wide (South England): A standing daily performance target of ten app signups and ten Google reviews per site has been set, with a proposal to gamify it so the teams engage with it.

Region-wide (South England): Front of house sometimes ask for a review from a table that has had a poor experience; staff must read the table and check satisfaction before asking, and management should routinely check in on section status.
Region-wide (South England): Sites must report the status of their envelope returns to the office.
Two new starters joined the England BOH weekly meeting for the first time, covering the sushi section.
A sushi team member is leaving this month and another leaves on 29/09/2026, but the section is covered by a fully trained full time starter plus two part timers, so no further sushi hiring is needed.
The ramen and front of house team is still bedding in and ran out of some items several times over the past fortnight, affecting customers, so extra is being ordered from this week.
Ordering is not covering the full week, so the site runs out of stock every weekend.
The kitchen porter area drain issue has been repaired and the site sink was fixed on 14/09/2026.
Orders are being sent to the wrong tables, which is causing mistakes in the kitchen, and front of house are focusing on problems rather than food running.
Respect between the front of house and back of house teams needs to improve on both sides.
Staff food orders are being placed at busy times and very close to closing, and lateness has been frequent in the kitchen.
Low rating reviews cited slow speed of service and music being too loud front of house, and tough noodles and over salty karaage back of house.
A beef line showed as zero stock on the stock dashboard, which was confirmed accurate after a scheduled delivery did not arrive.
A Hungry Panda launch with a thirty percent delivery promotion goes live the following Monday and is expected to be popular with the local student population.
The site was called out in the England BOH meeting as a strong performer for a new team.

Region-wide (England): The prep level list in the daily Mapal chef report is being replaced by a nightly main protein stock count, recorded on a printed sheet in the kitchen and photographed and uploaded to Mapal every night by whoever closes.

Region-wide (England): The AI daily stock ordering dashboard is only as accurate as the daily stock counts and timely invoice entry into Kobas, and two sites this week showed false shortage flags caused by invoice upload lag.
Region-wide (England): Operations is sourcing a new Char Siu and karaage manufacturer after supplier size inconsistency drove wastage and food cost.
